workflows.purpose: Answer a bounded question using authoritative evidence.
Investigate unknowns and reconcile source-backed findings.
Implement approved behavior and verify observable acceptance.
Reproduce a failure, establish its cause, fix and recheck.
Evaluate existing work against explicit acceptance with concrete evidence.
Compare alternatives against constraints before consequential execution.

topologies.solo: One owner handles coupled reasoning, shared invariants or bounded work.
topologies.sequential: Dependent delegated units proceed in verified producer-to-consumer order.
topologies.parallel: Substantial independently checkable branches have exclusive write/output scopes and one integrator.
topologies.generator-evaluator: Generation and selected-input evaluation are separate responsibilities.

templates.select_when: Work is bounded or coupled and delegation would mostly repeat context.
templates.avoid_when: Independent substantial work or consequential acceptance gaps justify another structure.

templates.select_when: Substantial independent discovery questions are the bottleneck before one owner synthesizes findings or builds.
templates.avoid_when: Questions depend on each other's artifacts, have coupled acceptance, or cost less to answer directly than to delegate.

templates.select_when: Substantial delivery units need accepted-artifact ordered handoffs, or are ready for concurrent work with agreed interfaces, non-overlapping scopes and independent checks; one owner integrates.
templates.avoid_when: Delegation mostly repeats context; separate files alone do not establish independence, and unresolved producer-consumer dependencies must not be run concurrently.

templates.select_when: Consequential defects or observed self-review gaps justify separate acceptance checking.
templates.avoid_when: A bounded task has adequate direct verification and another review adds no useful evidence.

templates.select_when: Durable delivery needs explicit state, artifact dependencies, recovery ownership and evidence-driven stage reselection; or explicitly authorized optimization has a correct baseline/oracle, representative comparable measurements and bounded resources.
templates.avoid_when: A short task needs no continuity layer, or proposed optimization lacks explicit authorization, correctness evidence or reliable measurements. Ordinary delivery continuity does not require a performance benchmark.

inference: The host AI selects the task category, one of five workflow families and the current-stage topology from task evidence, dependencies, risk and cost; it can reselect when evidence changes without changing original acceptance or authority. This catalog is not a keyword classifier, executable scheduler, runtime integration or universal optimum.
